# External simulator comparisons

These inputs and scripts reproduce device-stamp measurements with ngspice and
Xyce. They provide engineering comparisons, not portable timing baselines.

See [device-stamp](device-stamp/README.md) for the workloads, method, and
comparability limits. Save new observations, simulator versions, executable
digests, host configuration, and raw samples under ignored `target/benchmarks/`
or in CI artifacts. Historical measurements are available in Git history;
the source tree keeps only the reproduction tools and inputs.
